projects.title: ADVANCED WARFARE
projects.subtitle: Royal Menu — Custom UI Mod
projects.description: Designed and built a fully custom in-game menu UI for Advanced Warfare. Includes custom lobby screen, scoreboard layout, and HUD elements — all built from scratch with a focus on clean readability and immersive aesthetics.

projects.title: MODERN WARFARE R
projects.subtitle: Royal Menu — Tactical UI Kit
projects.description: A complete UI overhaul for Modern Warfare Remastered. Redesigned the menu flow, player cards, and match lobby with a tactical military aesthetic — sharp typography, minimal noise, maximum impact.

projects.title: WORLD WAR II
projects.subtitle: Royal Menu — Historical UI Theme
projects.description: Crafted a historically-inspired UI theme for COD WW2. Vintage typography, aged textures, and period-accurate design language — built to match the game's tone while keeping the interface clean and functional.
